resources.string: The full history is in CHANGELOG.md in the repository.

string-array.name: changelog_1_3_fixed
string-array.item: Renaming the receiver now updates the name senders see straight away — the mDNS advert, the Home screen and GET /info all agree.
A fresh install advertises Apple TV. If that name is already taken on the network, the Home screen shows the name that was really registered, such as Apple TV (2).
A sender that disappears mid-handshake no longer blocks the next device — no Restart needed.

string-array.name: changelog_1_3_improved
string-array.item: The AirPlay advert matches a real Apple TV more closely (protovers=1.1, manufacturer=Apple).
The advertised name is cleaned in one place, so stray characters can no longer corrupt the Bonjour record.

string-array.name: changelog_1_3_new
string-array.item: This changelog, under Settings → About → What\'s new.
A troubleshooting guide for the device name, and for casting from an iPhone app: Rumble offers both Apple Devices (AirPlay) and Google Devices (Cast).

string-array.name: changelog_earlier
string-array.item: 1.2.0 — releases publish themselves (a rolling latest build on every merge, plus numbered v* releases), and a 4K Google TV can mirror in 4K.
1.1 — Miracast really plays video, and error messages say what actually went wrong.
1.0.0-beta.1 — the first published build: the complete AirPlay 2 receiver (mirroring, FairPlay, HomeKit pairing, audio, photos).
